Finite independently written tests executed from checker.py returned ALL_CHECKS_OK, with 30 supports and four exhaustive full-unary-operation carrier counts. Finite checks are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-parameter complete census of unary modal expansions of fixed products of classical 2-valued and indeterminate 3-valued Kleene chains, the elementary building blocks of the new algebraic modal semantics. It also identifies the exact support-sensitive structural boundary: classical output atoms require matched neighborhoods, while nonclassical outputs permit independent nested neighborhoods or wholly inactive boxes. The formula distinguishes mixed products by far more than a tiny finite recomputation and supplies explicit exhaustive constructors.
